description: This Java source file implements the Authorities interface with a class AuthoritiesImpl that manages resource and operation authorities, including methods for adding authorities, creating from JWT claims, and checking authorization based on resource identifiers and activities.

classes.name: AuthoritiesImpl
classes.description: A final class implementing Authorities that manages resource and operation authorities, allowing addition, merging, and authorization checks.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates Authorities from JWT claims, adding claims with specific prefixes to authorities map.

methods.name: addOperation
methods.description: Adds an operation authority for a resource, with optional tenant, returning the instance for chaining.

methods.name: addResource
methods.description: Adds resource authorities with specified activities, supporting tenant segmentation.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Merges authorities from another Authorities object into this instance.

methods.name: isAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if a resource and activity or operation are authorized based on stored authorities.

methods.name: asMap
methods.description: Returns the authorities as a Map.
